EmailTemplate.subject: Happy Holidays from Flywire! Are you interested in a demo?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=there}},
I know we’re running out of time to connect before the year is over. How about we connect the week of January 16? I can send over an invitation and we can review how Flywire can help {{company.Company Name:default=your company}} in the new year.
If {{company.Company Name:default=your company}} has a lot of international customers, Flywire could be a great fit and I’d be excited to discuss how we can help save you money going into 2023!
In the meantime - check out our most recent case study <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/removing-travel-payments-roadblocks-nordic-visitor-forges-path-to-growth?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> on our only client offering trips to “Santa's official North Pole residence” to see why travel companies love using Flywire’s to process their payments.
Let me know and we’ll connect soon. Happy New Year!
Thanks,
Anne-Sophie
